title: Kriang (Nge) – Traditional Arts and Ethnology Centre
text: The Kriang, or Nge, are a small ethnic group living in southern Laos, primarily Sekong Province. They are part of the Austroasiatic ethnolinguistic family, and their language is related to that of the Arak and Katu. The Kriang are known for their skilled weaving on backstrap looms.
